front.title: Cross-Publisher Causal Ordering for YANG-Push Datastore Telemetry

abstract.t: In YANG-Push version 2, each publisher numbers its own notifications, and the numbers of two publishers are not comparable. When a single subscription is served by several publishers, for example on a multi- line-card router or a disaggregated routing stack, a collector cannot order updates across those publishers from the sequence numbers alone. This document defines an opt-in, coordination-free mechanism that carries a Comparability Scope, a coarse Causal-Epoch, and a per- publisher Local-Sequence-Number in the notification envelope. Publishers stay lock-free on the export fast path, and a collector reconstructs cross-publisher order within a bounded reordering window. A companion YANG module adds the subscription controls, the envelope metadata, and the capability discovery. The mechanism does not require synchronized clocks across publishers.
